note:
A4 R5: reproduce Letzkus, Kampa & Stuart 2006 Fig 1F (open circles) in the emodels: somatic 10-90 % rise time of an
artificial EPSP (aEPSC injected at an apical site) vs path distance. Anchored check, no free parameter.
aEPSC (Letzkus Methods, after Hausser & Roth 1997; A5 a5_lit/L23L5_TARGETS_CHECK.md lines 77-81, 103): double exponential,
tau_rise 0.2 ms, tau_decay 2 ms, peak 600 pA. Data: aEPSP rise 1.5 ms at the soma -> 4.1 ms at 700 um (r = 0.99), open
circles ~280 um at 2.7 ms and ~700 um at 4.1 ms. Unitary-EPSP line (filled circles, Fig 1F): ~80/110 um at 1.7 ms,
~180/225 at 2.2, ~315 at 2.4, ~505 at 3.4, ~850/955 at 4.1; fit line ~400-450 um at 2.7 ms (A5, same file lines 75-76).
Cell: single post cell, no synapses (pulse_residual.py / resdep_cell.py loading; SK_E2 handling per emodel as there).
Sites: soma, apical trunk (bluecellulab Cell.apical_trunk(): the max-diameter path) at 25, 50, 100 ... 700 um, and up to 2
non-trunk apical sites (oblique / tuft side branches, label 'branch') per distance (+-15 um). One injection every 150 ms
from 300 ms, fixed step 0.025 ms; all sites at 600 pA, then all sites again at 60 pA (linearity reference).
Per site: baseline = mean V 2 ms before; amp = peak - baseline within 80 ms; rise 10-90 % and 20-80 % (SH06 measure).
Spike flags (R6/R7, coordinator 2026-10-06; R5 run had ~30-117 mV somatic events at 600-700 um). Recomputed at merge:
  soma_ap    somatic V peak > -20 mV or somatic max dV/dt > 50 mV/ms (passive soma injection: ~13 mV, <15 mV/ms)
  dend_spike lin_ratio = amp(600 pA) / (10 x amp(60 pA)) > 1.2 (supralinear somatic response), or local V 10 ms after
             onset (current < 1 % of peak) exceeds 10 x its 60 pA value by > 10 mV (supralinear local response)
  unsettled  baseline jumps > 1.5 mV from the previous site in run order, or is > 4 mV off the run median
             (a previous event not decayed; a slow drift of rest, e.g. the new-emodel passive variant, is not flagged)
  (R6 v1 rules, replaced: local dV10 > 15 mV alone flagged passive thin branches of the new emodel, tau 425 ms;
   baseline vs the soma site > 2 mV flagged every site of the drifting new-passive run.)
  excluded = any flag; the 600 pA curves and 2.7 ms crossings use non-excluded sites only; the 60 pA curve uses sites
  whose 60 pA baseline is settled.
Also shown: the model's own unitary L2/3->L5 EPSP rise vs pair mean path distance (pair_geometry csv, per emodel).
  python rise_vs_distance.py --task K      (K 0-9: emodel x cell, as pulse_residual.CELLS)  | --emodel E --pair P
  python rise_vs_distance.py --merge       -> out/a4_letzkus_fig1f.csv, figs/A4_R5_rise_vs_distance.png + _data.json
